fishing: WHEN: strong solunar today. PASSES-BEACH: snook, whiting, jacks, pompano at Stump Pass/Manasota beaches. LEMON BAY: redfish schools hot, some trout. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper, grunts, grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, cut bait, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis not observed statewide past week; no SWFL bloom.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (latest ~20 CFU); Charlotte sites clear.
